title: clabtoolkit: A Python toolkit for neuroimaging data processing and analysis
description:
clabtoolkit is a Python toolkit for neuroimaging data processing and analysis, designed for brain connectivity data, BIDS datasets and the file formats used in neuroimaging.

Documentation: https://clabtoolkit.readthedocs.io
